title: By the stern stone hand of Grattan
html_source: Another nearby statue of Irish politician Henry Grattan (1746-1820); he is portrayed declaiming, with his arm raised above his head.

anchor.text: By the stern stone hand of Grattan
anchor.prefix:
hen said smiling, swaying his ashplant in slow swingswong from its midpoint, lightly. 

— Speriamo, the round mustachioed face said pleasantly. Ma, dia retta a me. Ci rifletta.
anchor.suffix:
, bidding halt, an Inchicore tram unloaded straggling Highland soldiers of a band. 

 — Ci rifletteró, Stephen said, glancing down the solid trouserleg.
